_note: Configuration presets consumed by scripts/auto-populate-configuration.py. Each preset declares the parameters of the Pareto + floor + cost-sort algorithm. Floor values are percentages of the top intelligence score within a bucket. Cost ceilings are $/M blended tokens. The 'mode' field switches the algorithm path: 'paid_intelligence' (Premium/Optimum/Budget) operates over paid models; 'free_intelligence' operates over the free models list with no cost math.

premium.description: Highest-ranking models available; cost ignored. Best-of-bucket per slot.

optimum.description: Cheapest within the top 80% intelligence band. Most users land here.

budget.description: Cheapest within a looser 50% intelligence floor AND a cost ceiling. If fewer than top-N pass both bounds, the algorithm loosens floor first, then ceiling, until top-N pass. Loosening events are reported in the output metadata.

free.description: Free-tier models only. Pareto-pruned, intelligence-descending. Free Models Router included as the first option when available.

analysis.gear4._note: When diversity is enforced for the workhorse pair, breadth picks exclude depth's primary so the second slot reaches for a different model family.

analysis.gear3._note: gear3.breadth stays null — sequential mode uses depth only.

image_generation._note: Picks from AA's text-to-image arena leaderboard. Ranked by Elo (stored in aa_intelligence_index, same field chat models use for intelligence). All four presets currently produce the same picks because we lack pricing data for image models — Premium/Optimum/Budget/Free distinctions kick in once $/1k images is wired into the catalog.

vision_substitute._note: Vision substitute picks come from the large bucket filtered to vision_capable=True. Threaded into every cell's vision_substitute field.
